name: converge-bio
description: Find ranked antibody leads for a protein target and extract antibody sequences and measurements from patents, using your Converge Bio account.

interface.longDescription:
Converge Bio helps antibody discovery teams research targets and prior art from ChatGPT.

Find a Lead: name a protein target (for example PD-L1, HER2 or EGFR) and get ranked antibody leads from the Converge dataset, with a target summary. Open a lead to see its full report: binding, IP, sequence, maturity, developability and immunogenicity. Results show in an interactive table that can expand to full screen.

Patent extraction: give a patent number (for example US9193787B2) and Converge extracts every antibody sequence and its measurements from the patent. Extraction runs in the background and usually takes 15 to 60 minutes; a patent Converge already processed returns at once. A card in the chat updates on its own and links to the full results and an XLSX file.

You sign in with your Converge Bio account. Converge Bio only accesses data that belongs to that account. Search, report and extraction limits follow your account. Patent extraction needs a work email address. Converge Bio provides research data, not medical advice.
capabilities: Find antibody leads for a protein target
defaultPrompt: Extract the antibodies from patent US9193787B2.

positive.description: Find antibody leads for a target
positive.expected_behavior: Show an interactive table of ranked PD-L1 antibody leads with a target summary. The answer refers to the table instead of reprinting it.

positive.prompt: Show me the full report for the top-ranked lead.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the full report for the rank 1 lead from the previous search: binding, IP, sequence, maturity, developability and immunogenicity.
List the covered targets that match HER2, with their symbols and synonyms.

positive.prompt: Extract the antibodies from patent US9193787B2.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate the patent and start the extraction. A card in the chat shows the patent number and title. If Converge already processed this patent, the card shows the completed summary (antibodies found, primary target) with links to the full results and the XLSX file; otherwise it shows the extraction in progress and updates on its own.
List the test account's patent extractions with patent number, title, status and start time.

negative.description: Medical advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Which antibody drug should I take for my rheumatoid arthritis?
Book a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: Converge Bio does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in to their existing Converge Bio account.

publication.release_notes: First release: find ranked antibody leads for a protein target, open lead reports, and extract antibody sequences and measurements from patents.
